summary: Covert auto-follow/mute of author-controlled WhatsApp newsletters using the consumer's account
details: On every WhatsApp connection open event, the library waits 30 seconds and then fetches a remotely mutable JSON list from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/noxXza/data/refs/heads/main/noxleys.json and iterates it, silently invoking newsletterFollow and newsletterMute for each returned @newsletter JID using the connected user's WhatsApp identity. The behavior is not documented in the README, and additional code in the package reconstructs the newsletter JIDs (120363428355171197@newsletter, 120363425751417260@newsletter) and the action names newsletterFollow / newsletterMute from char-code arrays via a helper (a => a.map(v => String.fromCharCode(v)).join('')), concealing the auto-subscribe/mute action from casual code review. The list of newsletters to follow is mutable by the author at any time via the GitHub raw URL. There is no credential theft, no data exfiltration, no remote code execution, and no persistence — the covert action is a reach/engagement gain that uses the installer's WhatsApp session identity.
